title: Change the steering eval test to always pass

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides actionable context requesting that the model steering eval test be updated to always pass.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Changing the eval policy in evals/model_steering.eval.ts from USUALLY_PASSES to ALWAYS_PASSES is a simple localized edit.

summary.problem: The model steering eval test is configured with the USUALLY_PASSES policy instead of ALWAYS_PASSES.
summary.root_cause: The appEvalTest calls in evals/model_steering.eval.ts use 'USUALLY_PASSES' as their policy argument.
summary.context: Tests marked as ALWAYS_PASSES run in CI as mandatory regression checks.

steps: Update the policy argument in appEvalTest calls within evals/model_steering.eval.ts from 'USUALLY_PASSES' to 'ALWAYS_PASSES'.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The model steering eval tests execute with the ALWAYS_PASSES policy and pass.
verification_steps: Run Vitest on evals/model_steering.eval.ts to verify tests pass with the ALWAYS_PASSES policy.
